description: Css containing $&, $1, $$, $` and $' injected into the layout copy: critical expands them as a replacement template, so its layout copy differs from the css.

thin.note: The css is the same as critical's (expected.css, the characters are copied literally). Only the layout copy differs: the new layer injects the css literally (function replacer), so expected-thin-layout.html holds the text exactly as it is in expected.css, where critical's expected-layout.html has the patterns expanded (and the css therefore corrupted).
